levels.L2: REFERENCE_ARCHITECTURE: doctrine, concept, private architecture, or integration candidate; not executable recruiter proof.
levels.L1: STUDY_OR_UPSTREAM: upstream/sample/mirror/fork/study or unverified owner-estate experiment; never recruiter authorship proof without promotion evidence.
levels.L0: QUARANTINED: unsafe, sensitive, misleading, duplicate-unresolved, or materially failing.
